description: Create a new Incident Severity in OneUptime. Returns the created Incident Severity object with its ID. Use this to add new Incident Severities to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

color.description: Color of this resource in Hex (#32a852 for example).

description.description: Friendly description that will help you remember.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

name.description: Any friendly name of this object.

order.description: Where this severity ranks among the project's incident severities: 1 is the most severe. A new severity without a number goes to the end of the list. Setting a number moves the severity to that place, and the ones in between shift by one. In the dashboard, drag the rows to reorder them.

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.
